note: Re-judged 2026-10-18 (independent auditor, after a78870fd39). RFC 9568 Section 5.1.1.3 says "A VRRP Router receiving a packet with the TTL not equal to 255 MUST discard the packet [RFC5082]." TestDecodeGoldenV3IPv4 now decodes the RFC 9568 message-only golden G2 under the default-mode lookup instead of the pseudo-header golden G2c, and lost only the removed MsgOnlyChecksum assertion; the subtests of TestNegativeReferenceBugs other than N1 gained only the FillChecksum mode argument. The positive is still a fully conforming advert, the checksum check precedes the checks this row names so a wrong form would fail with ErrChecksum and not pass silently, and each negative still asserts its exact sentinel. N4 with TTL 64 still requires ErrTTL, and TestInstanceRxDiscardsBadTTLTypeAndCountZero, unchanged, proves the discard. Verdict unchanged.
